summary: I am working on whether the automatic judges that score refusals give the right answer on language models with layers removed, and on how layer skipping trades speed against refusing harmful requests.
I am working on whether the copies of one vector-database shard return the same search results when nothing has failed, and what makes them differ.

I am working on how often a scaffold audit gives the wrong verdict when its margin comes from a small pilot run, and on how much a search scaffold can gain over budget-matched restarts of its own base searcher.
